description.value:
You let the borrowed strength go. Attempt a Fortitude save against the release DC (your Release DC); after a failed Call the DC is 2 higher. The same save is posted on its own when Communion runs out.

  • Critical Success You let go cleanly. Communion ends.
  • Success As critical success.
  • Failure Communion ends and your muscles tear on the way down: you lose Hit Points equal to twice your attunement. This is not damage, so temporary Hit Points and resistances don't reduce it.
  • Critical Failure Communion ends, you lose Hit Points equal to four times your attunement, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, and the Ansu won't answer your Call until the lockout ends: your next night's rest at Trial, 1 hour at Discipline, 10 minutes at Union.
